(2) The male character wakes up, opening his mouth wide in a yawn and stretching both arms upwards. (3) He suddenly leans over and vigorously shakes the female character's shoulder; she wakes up with a startled, angry expression and wide eyes. (4) The scene transitions to grayscale, and a large red 'X' appears over the screen along with variety text. (5) The scene resets to the beginning; the male wakes up again, but this time he looks at the sleeping female with a calm and affectionate gaze. (6) A close-up shot focuses on the female's face as she sleeps peacefully with a small drool bubble emerging from her mouth. (7) The male character gently leans in and gives her a soft hug as she remains asleep. (8) He uses his hand to pat her head in a comforting gesture. (9) He reaches down and carefully pulls the pale green blanket up to cover her chest. (10) He places a small white cat figure beside her; she smiles in her sleep, and a large green checkmark appears on the screen.
